funds.name: Sample Flexi Cap Fund
funds.about: A flexi cap fund can hold companies of different sizes. How it is split is decided by the fund manager.

funds.name: Sample Index Fund
funds.about: An index fund follows a market index instead of picking companies one by one. Its value moves with that index.

funds.name: Sample Mid Cap Fund
funds.about: A mid cap fund mainly holds medium-sized companies. Its value can move up and down more than many other types.

funds.name: Sample Multi Asset Fund
funds.about: A multi asset fund spreads money across more than one kind of asset, such as shares and bonds.

funds.name: Sample Small Cap Fund
funds.about: A small cap fund mainly holds smaller companies. Its value can move up and down a lot.
